title: package.json with a Crust build configuration
description: package.json schema for CLIs built with Crust. Point "$schema" at ./node_modules/@crustjs/crust/schema/package.json to get completion for the "crust" block alongside the standard package.json fields.

crust.description: Build configuration read by `crust build`. `artifact` is required unless every build passes --artifact; the other keys are optional. Unknown keys fail the build. Command names and their source entries come from the standard `bin` field.

runtime.description: Runtime the CLI is built for. Without it: @types/node without @types/bun selects node; otherwise bun.

artifact.description: What `crust build` distributes; the --artifact flag overrides it. `package`: a root-only runtime package whose commands are JavaScript bundles run by the consumer's installed runtime (bun or node). `binary`: standalone executables in per-platform npm packages behind a Node launcher (bun or node; node binaries are built by tsdown with a node on PATH that meets its executable requirements, Node 26 or later for the bundled tsdown 0.23).

targets.description: Canonical compiler targets of a binary release: Bun names for the bun runtime (bun-linux-x64, …), Node names for node (linux-x64, …). `crust build` stages them when no --target flag is passed, and `crust publish` requires every one; without the list, `crust build` stages only the building machine's target and `crust publish` of binaries fails. Rejected for runtime packages.

bunPlugins.description: Bun bundler plugin modules applied to Bun binaries and runtime packages (bun or node), in order: bare names resolve from node_modules, paths from the project root; each must default-export the plugin. Rejected for node binaries.

include.description: Directories relative to the project root that `crust build` copies into .crust/root/ and into each platform package's bin/.

external.description: Packages left out of a node or bun runtime package's bundle and shipped as `dependencies` of the staged root package with their package.json `dependencies` range, e.g. native addons, packages the CLI reads files from or runs, or very large dependencies. Each must be a `dependencies` key with a publishable range (no workspace:, catalog:, file:, link:, portal:, local paths, or local tarballs); @crustjs/* packages and npm aliases of them are rejected. Rejected for binaries.
